title: A Mars Rover Broke the Off-World Driving Record by 60 Meters

scenes.text: A robot on Mars broke the off-world driving record.
In October 2026, NASA's Perseverance passed 45.22 kilometers of total driving.
The old record belonged to Opportunity, which stopped at 45.16 kilometers in 2018.
The margin is only about 60 meters.
More than 90 percent of Perseverance's driving was done on autopilot, choosing its own path.
No machine has ever driven farther on another world.

description:
A robot on Mars broke the off-world driving record.
In October 2026, NASA's Perseverance rover passed Opportunity's total of 45.16 kilometers, reaching 45.22. Most of its driving was done on autopilot.
What should the next Mars rover explore?
first_comment: Opportunity held the record for eight years. Did you expect it to fall by only 60 meters?
